entries.definitionSummary: 飲み込んだ後に口に残る味わいを表す官能評価語。

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists あと味 as aftertaste, a term expressing taste.

entries.notes: Source-backed terminology. Any Body/Voice interpretation is a separate experimental bridge layer.

entries.definitionSummary: あと味の評価語で、味が後まで残らない側を表す。初心者向けには「切れが良い」と説明できる。

provenance.sourceName: 酒類総合研究所「清酒の官能評価分析における香味に関する品質評価用語及び標準見本」
provenance.transformationNote: The NRIB terminology places きれ under あと味.

provenance.sourceName: 国税庁「きき酒用語」掲載資料
provenance.transformationNote: Used only to corroborate the familiar explanatory wording 「切れが良い」; canonical display remains きれ.

entries.notes: The parent relationship is dictionary structure, not a duration-only or motion mapping.

entries.definitionSummary: 口あたりのきめ・舌触りが滑らかなことを表す官能評価語。

everydayLanguageCandidates.text: 舌触りが滑らかな感じ

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary identifies なめらか as smooth and a texture term.

entries.notes: Separate from まるい: this entry concerns texture/fineness, not low stimulation.

entries.definitionSummary: 刺激味が少ない側の、丸みのある口あたりを表す官能評価語。

everydayLanguageCandidates.text: 刺激が少なく丸みのある感じ

provenance.sourceName: 酒類総合研究所「清酒の官能評価分析における香味に関する品質評価用語及び標準見本」
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB terminology treats まるい as the low-stimulation side of mouthfeel.

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists まるい as round/mellow texture terminology.

entries.notes: Not a synonym for なめらか and not a generic shape mapping.

entries.definitionSummary: 酸による味わいを表す基本味の官能評価語。

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists 酸味 as acid/sourness, a term expressing taste.

entries.notes: Reference-only for the MVP bridge; no shape:sharp relationship is retained.

entries.definitionSummary: うま味を表す基本味の官能評価語。

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists うま味 as savory taste/umami, a term expressing taste.

entries.definitionSummary: 甘さを表す基本味の官能評価語。

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists 甘味 as sweetness, a term expressing taste.

entries.notes: Reference-only for the MVP bridge; added after human semantic review.

entries.definitionSummary: 軽快で繊細な味わいを表す、濃淡・body文脈の官能評価語。

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists 淡麗 as light body/light and delicate taste.

provenance.sourceName: 国税庁「きき酒用語」掲載資料
provenance.transformationNote: Used to corroborate the term as a public tasting vocabulary item.

entries.notes: Reference-only. No weight:light or movement shortcut is retained.

entries.definitionSummary: 豊かで厚みのある味わいを表す、濃淡・body文脈の官能評価語。

everydayLanguageCandidates.text: 豊かで厚みのある味わい

provenance.sourceName: NRIB Japanese Sake Essentials — Sensory Evaluation Terms
provenance.transformationNote: NRIB glossary lists 濃醇 as full body/rich and full taste.

provenance.sourceName: 国税庁「きき酒用語」掲載資料
provenance.transformationNote: Used to corroborate the term as a public tasting vocabulary item.
